title: Output of the scenario-scene agent: the plans of ONE scene

plans.description: The scene's plans, in reading order. Order is that of the array: no plan number.

titre.description: (French) Title of the plan, distinct from the other titles.

description.description: (French) What happens in this plan, then its dialogue lines, if any.

liaison.description: How this plan links to the previous one. suite: its render directly continues the previous plan's ending. coupe: clean cut.

tempsFort.description: True only for the plan that carries the scene moment marked « (temps fort) », at most one in the scene; false otherwise. Never write the mark in a text.

inventions.description: (French) Additions that the inputs do not hold.

notes.description: (French) Limitations to report. Empty if none.
